description: This file defines a wrapper function around the standard fopen to handle extra checks such as directory existence, and manages platform-specific macro considerations. It includes a specific header file 'git-compat-util.h' and maintains macro redefinitions to ensure portability across platforms.

methods.name: FILE * git_fopen(const char * path,const char * mode)
methods.description: A wrapper around fopen that checks if the path is a directory and handles errors accordingly, returning NULL on failure or when the path is a directory.
